author: rex-Phantom
quote: Where do I even begin? The game mechanics are sluggish and poor and the premise of the story is incredibly shallow and ridiculous This is completely uncharacteristic of Rockstar while their GTA stories are usually simple or straightforward GTA 6 features the absolute worst narrative in the entire series Then there are the technical issues the game is riddled with glitches. After six years of development, it’s still full of bugs and errors it’s a disaster. The gameplay system is incredibly lazy it’s essentially a copy-paste job from Red Dead Redemption 2 which wasn’t even that great to begin with it’s slow and boring They even gave Jason, Arthur Morgan Dead Eye ability which just goes to show a total lack of creativity and innovation on the part of Rockstar developers As for Jason himself, he’s basically an NPC he barely speaks and has no real say in any decisions It’s infuriating he feels like nothing more than a shadow to Lucia or perhaps her pet dog. His dialogue is poor and superficial The only decent moment involving him was when he sacrificed himself to save Lucia that’s it As for the missions they’re absolute trash genuinely bad and completely uninspired
